propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated plan reviews walking the relation graph.

Empty ticket directories are created by os.makedirs before the first event is written, and persist if the write process dies before staging the event; they are invisible to git and cannot be tracked in the tickets branch.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a warning, rather than failing the entire snapshot, since such directories carry no relation information needed for the snapshot.
The writer will continue creating ticket directories before their first event to avoid concurrency races; the reader-side tolerance is the sole fix applied.
